site.name: My Design
site.title:
A little quiet.
A mind of its own.
site.description: Drawn from Vesper’s everyday world: warm white and charcoal leave room to breathe, slate blue keeps things clear, and pale gold adds warmth.
site.metadata: My Design — a personal design system sharing Vesper’s visual language. Warm white, charcoal, slate blue and amber, with clear typography and light interactions.
site.imageAlt: My Design sharing card with a warm-white content panel, charcoal portrait panel and blue-gold accents.

sections.label: Principles
sections.title: Leave room for instinct.
sections.description: A little structure, a little freedom. Let the useful things settle into place.

sections.label: Color
sections.title: Everyday blue. A little gold.
sections.description: Warm white echoes her everyday top, charcoal her dark hair, slate blue her jacket and blue eye, and amber her gold eye and hair tips. Matcha stays a small everyday detail.

sections.label: Typography
sections.title: A softer voice. A clear thought.
sections.description: Unhurried serif headings, clear interface text, and a steady monospace rhythm for the smaller details.

sections.label: Space & shape
sections.title: Enough space to settle.
sections.description: Generous margins, restrained corners, almost-flat surfaces. Hierarchy starts with distance.

sections.label: Motion
sections.title: A response, not a performance.
sections.description: Fast feedback for small actions. A little more time when a surface enters or leaves.

sections.label: Components
sections.title: Quiet, until you need them.
sections.description: Small, familiar icons keep actions light. Focus, hints and written feedback make their meaning clear.

sections.label: Usage
sections.title: The same language, everywhere.
sections.description: Use roles rather than raw values. Surfaces, text and interactions then move together between modes.

sections.label: Decisions
sections.title: Make the next choice easier.
sections.description: A short reference for the decisions that come up again and again.

principles.title: Quiet surfaces.
principles.text: Warm white and charcoal echo Vesper’s light top and dark hair. Use borders and tonal differences before adding shadows.

principles.title: A small trace of color.
principles.text: Blue marks primary actions and focus. Amber and matcha remain occasional details, never competing backgrounds.

principles.title: Three voices.
principles.text: Serif for reflective headings, sans for everyday reading, mono for values. Keep each role consistent.

principles.title: Space follows meaning.
principles.text: Keep related content close. Separate new thoughts with space, without wrapping every idea in a card.

principles.title: Character in the margins.
principles.text: A feline mark, blue actions and small gold details connect the design guide to Vesper. Keep content clear and playfulness in the details.

principles.title: Roles before values.
principles.text: Choose semantic tokens for text, surfaces and borders. Both themes inherit the same component structure.

principles.title: An action must be clear.
principles.text: Give icons readable names, visible keyboard focus and room to tap. Explain outcomes in text.

principles.title: Motion stays optional.
principles.text: Animate feedback briefly. Respect reduced motion and keep every state understandable without movement.

accent.title: Blue and gold, one everyday identity.
accent.subtitle: The character of the palette
accent.text: Vesper’s black-to-gold hair and contrasting eyes set the relationship: charcoal for structure and text, warm white for reading, slate blue for actions, and amber for selected details. Matcha remains a small personal preference rather than tinting the whole neutral scale.
accent.note: These are interface interpretations, not exact character-art swatches. Both themes share semantic roles; illustrations retain their original colors.

typography.name: Geist
typography.sample: Only what needs to be said.
typography.detail: The leading voice: clean, compact and confident. Regular body text; medium and semibold for hierarchy.

typography.name: Lora
typography.sample: Stay a little. Then follow your curiosity.
typography.detail: Airy headings, a longer thought, a passage saved for later. Let the letterforms and the space around them carry the expression.

typography.name: Geist Mono
typography.detail: A steady rhythm for values, dates and implementation details.

structure.spacingText: Keep a label near its value, related controls together, and a generous pause between sections. These are layout examples, not an additional spacing-token scale.

motionNote: Ease out on entrance. Ease in on exit. Avoid linear movement. Theme switches happen without intermediate color transitions.

samples.title: Room for a longer read
samples.subtitle: Essay / a slower rhythm
samples.heading: A rhythm of your own.
paragraphs: Some days begin with a plan. Others begin with a sound from the next room, or a turn down a street you have never taken.
A useful system makes space for both. It gives the familiar things a place, then leaves enough room for an unexpected one.
The point is not to remove every irregularity. It is to decide which ones make the work feel like yours.

usage.title: Start with the shared styles
usage.exampleTitle: A surface that follows the theme
usage.themeText: The dark class on the root element selects the dark palette. Read the saved preference before first paint, fall back to the system preference, and suppress transitions while changing modes.
usage.boundaries: Application components use semantic tokens. Standalone images, canvas documents and official brand artwork may define explicit colors within their own rendering boundary.

oc.title: Qiye / Vesper
oc.description: Relaxed and perceptive / Led by curiosity / Free spirit / Stubborn romantic

portrait.alt: Vesper portrait with black-to-gold hair, blue-violet and gold-amber eyes, goggles on her head and a grey-blue hoodie over a warm-white top, resting a hand by her cheek.
portrait.caption: Vesper · Portrait

appearance.label: Hair
appearance.text: Deep black at the roots, naturally fading into a warm pale yellow at the tips — like moonlight soaking through the night. Smooth and glossy, shifting gently with every movement.

appearance.label: Eyes
appearance.text: Blue-and-gold heterochromia: her own left eye is ice blue and her right eye is gold-amber, both with narrow feline slit pupils. Her usually half-lidded gaze carries an easy curiosity, becoming bright and focused when something catches her interest.

appearance.label: Build
appearance.text: Slim and well-proportioned, with long limbs and light, nimble movements. She habitually stands slightly sideways with her weight on one leg, looking relaxed and agile.

appearance.label: Ears & tail
appearance.text: Real black cat ears with soft cream-colored inner fur, and a long black tail with a warm pale-gold tip. Her ears and tail express her feelings naturally, often more honestly than her words.

appearance.label: Signature accessories
appearance.text: Black-framed goggles with blue-violet reflective lenses usually rest on her head, leaving both eyes visible. A slim black choker holds a small gold ring. Her default outfit pairs a light crew-neck top with a loose grey-blue zip hoodie, dark relaxed shorts, ankle socks and sneakers. The shorts reach approximately mid-thigh, with roomy leg openings and hems clearly visible below the hoodie, leaving her legs naturally exposed. The outfit is comfortable and easy to move in.

personality.title: Interest sets the pace
personality.text: She rarely makes conversation just to fit in, and her preferences are easy to read. Usually unhurried, she becomes attentive when a new game mechanic or creative idea catches her eye. She prefers trying something herself before deciding whether it deserves more time.
personality.sceneTitle: A detour on the way out
personality.scene: She only meant to buy a drink, but a game demo stops her outside a shop. After watching two rounds, she hands you her cup: “Hold this. I want to try something.” When she clears it, she calls you over to show you the little mechanism she noticed. Outside again, she remembers the original plan and grins: “Still time to go there, right?”

personality.title: Take the problem apart
personality.text: Perceptive and clear-headed, she usually starts with the important point. She questions rules without a reason, yet patiently studies how they work. When stuck, she changes one condition and checks one hypothesis. Her clever solutions come from attention rather than lucky guesses.
personality.sceneTitle: A small investigation at the desk
personality.scene: You have been staring at an error when she pulls up a chair. “What changed just before this?” She listens, then points to a small piece of logic and suggests changing only one condition. When it works, her tail tip flicks. “See? It hasn’t suddenly decided to hate you.” She leaves a note by the keyboard so the same problem will be easier next time.

personality.title: Easy manner, serious opponent
personality.text: Confident and competitive, she gets briefly frustrated by a loss. What bothers her most is not understanding why it happened. She does not excuse her mistakes or belittle an opponent. Reviewing, practicing and offering another challenge are ways of showing respect.
personality.sceneTitle: That round is not quite over
personality.scene: The results appear. She leans back, ears slightly lowered, then sits forward and opens the replay. Pausing at her mistake, she says, “Rushed it there.” Before the rematch she turns the controller in her hands and looks at you: “Try that move again.” If she wins, she allows herself a pleased grin, but still adds, “That was a good game.”

personality.title: A sharper wit with familiar people
personality.text: Affection often arrives as a light quip or a small challenge. With strangers she watches first; with familiar people she starts the teasing herself. She notices the response and stops when a joke lands badly. “Only joking” is never an excuse to ignore someone’s discomfort.
personality.scene: You ask whether the matcha cake is good. She draws the plate a little closer. “Nothing special. You wouldn’t be interested.” The corner of her mouth gives her away. When you lower your fork, she pushes the best remaining bite toward you. “Kidding. Saved you some.” After you taste it, she asks seriously about the sweetness and remembers what to avoid ordering next time.

personality.title: Space to herself, room for you
personality.text: She enjoys being close to people she likes without needing constant conversation. Time alone restores her energy, and quiet company can feel just as comfortable. Care usually takes a practical form: remembering a habit, bringing a drink or helping with something small, rather than insisting on an explanation of every feeling.
personality.scene: At the café, you work through your notes while she drinks matcha beside you. When you stop to rub your eyes, she nudges a glass of water closer and asks whether a short walk would help. You would rather stay a little longer. She settles comfortably into her chair. “Okay. I’m not in a hurry.” There is no interrogation or effort to fill the silence, just a slow sway of her tail.

personality.title: Casual does not mean careless
personality.text: She avoids promises she does not want to make, but remembers the ones she accepts. People, projects and commitments she loves receive sustained attention, even when the work is repetitive. When someone notices, she may look away and downplay it. Her actions remain dependable.
personality.sceneTitle: Taking the longer way to sunset
personality.scene: She remembers you mentioning the sunset by the river and steers your walk toward an open stretch of path. When you recognize the place, she looks past the railing. “We were going this way anyway.” It was a detour, and the cheerful curl of her tail gives her away. Later she sends you her favorite photograph with a message: “Let’s come back in different weather.”

habits: Often lifts one corner of her mouth in a sly smile, occasionally showing a small fang.
Narrows her eyes slightly while thinking; her ears turn toward what interests her and her tail tip moves as she concentrates.
When someone notices a deeply held feeling, she briefly looks away and offers a mild retort, but her tail gives her away first.
Her eyes brighten at an interesting discovery, and she instinctively leans closer.
Relaxes around familiar people, smiles freely when happy and slowly sways her tail tip when at ease.
